details.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "virtual_schools_count" FROM "schools" JOIN "satscores" ON "schools"."cdscode" = "satscores"."cds" WHERE "schools"."virtual" = '1' AND "satscores"."avgscrmath" > 400 LIMIT 1

details.question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."cdscode" AS "cdscode", SUM("frpm"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_enrollment" FROM "schools" JOIN "frpm" ON "schools"."cdscode" = "frpm"."cdscode" GROUP BY "schools"."cdscode" HAVING SUM("frpm"."Enrollment (K-12)") > 500

details.question: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
details.sql: SELECT MAX("frpm"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)") AS "highest_eligible_free_rate" FROM "frpm" JOIN "satscores" ON "frpm"."cdscode" = "satscores"."cds" WHERE "satscores"."numtsttakr" > 0.3 ORDER BY "highest_eligible_free_rate" DESC

details.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."charternum" AS "charternum", AVG("satscores"."avgscrwrite") AS "avg_writing_score" FROM "satscores" JOIN "schools" ON "satscores"."cds" = "schools"."cdscode" WHERE "satscores"."avgscrwrite" > 499 GROUP BY "schools"."charternum" ORDER BY "avg_writing_score" DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.
details.sql: SELECT f."School Name", s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip AS full_address FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE ABS(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30 ORDER BY ABS(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") DESC

details.question: Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?
Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is grater than 400, what is the funding type of these schools?
details.sql:
SELECT s.school, s.fundingtype
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cds
WHERE s.city = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.school, s.fundingtype
HAVING AVG(sa.avgscrmath) > 400

details.question: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which has more than 800 free or reduced price meals for ages 15-17?
details.sql: SELECT f."School Name", s."mailstreet", s."mailstrabr", s."mailcity", s."mailzip", s."mailstate" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey' AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)' AND s."soctype" = 'High Schools (Public)' AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

details.question: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."school" AS "school", AVG("schools"."soc") AS "avg_soc", COUNT("schools"."soc") AS "soc_count" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."opendate" >= '1991-01-01' AND "schools"."closeddate" <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY "schools"."school" ORDER BY "avg_soc" DESC

details.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
details.sql: WITH avg_diff AS (SELECT AVG("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference FROM frpm WHERE "Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'), school_diffs AS (SELECT frpm."School Name", s."doctype", frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" - frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17) AS diff FROM frpm s ON frpm."School Code" = s."nceschool" WHERE "Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded') SELECT "School Name", "doctype" FROM school_diffs WHERE diff > (SELECT avg_difference FROM avg_diff) ORDER BY diff DESC

details.question: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?
details.sql: SELECT "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" FROM frpm f ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

details.question: What is the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for the top 5 schools in grades 1-12 with the highest free or reduced price meal count of the schools with the ownership code 66?
What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
details.sql: SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state FROM schools s JOIN satscores sc ON s.cdscode = sc.cds ORDER BY (sc.avgscrread + sc.avgscrmath + sc.avgscrwrite) / 3.0 ASC LIMIT 1

details.question: Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.
details.sql: SELECT MAX("satscores"."numge1500") AS "numge1500", MAX("schools"."admfname3") AS "admfname3", MAX("schools"."admlname3") AS "admlname3" FROM "satscores" JOIN "schools" ON "satscores"."cds" = "schools"."cdscode" ORDER BY "numge1500" DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
details.sql: SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr) AS avg_test_takers FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.cdscode WHERE sch.county = 'Fresno' AND sch.opendate >= '1980-01-01' AND sch.opendate <= '1980-12-31'

details.question: What is the telephone number for the school with the lowest average score in reading in Fresno Unified?
details.sql: SELECT s.phone FROM satscores sc JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.cdscode WHERE sc.dname = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY sc.avgscrread ASC LIMIT 1

details.question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
details.sql:
WITH school_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.school,
        s.county,
        AVG(sc.avgscrread) as avg_read
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sc ON s.cdscode = sc.cds
    WHERE s.virtual = '1'
    GROUP BY s.school, s.county
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        school,
        county,
        avg_read,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avg_read DESC) as rank
    FROM school_stats
)
SELECT school
FROM ranked_schools
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY school

details.question: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."school" AS "school_name", AVG("satscores"."avgscrwrite") AS "avg_writing_score" FROM "satscores" JOIN "schools" ON "satscores"."cds" = "schools"."cdscode" WHERE "schools"."admfname1" = 'Ricci' AND "schools"."admlname1" = 'Ulrich' GROUP BY "schools"."school"

details.question: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
details.sql: SELECT "School Name", "District Type", "Enrollment (K-12)" FROM frpm f WHERE "District Type" = 'State Special Schools' AND "Low Grade" = '1' AND "High Grade" = '12' ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."opendate" AS "opendate", AVG("schools"."opendate") AS "avg_opendate" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."county" = 'Alameda County' AND "schools"."district" = 'Elementary School District' AND "schools"."opendate" >= '1980-01-01' AND "schools"."opendate" <= '1980-12-31' GROUP BY "schools"."opendate" ORDER BY "opendate" ASC LIMIT 100

details.question: What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
details.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Orange' AND "District Type" = 'Unified School District' AND "School Type" = 'Merged School')::float / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Orange' AND "District Type" = 'Elementary School District' AND "School Type" = 'Merged School')::float, 0) AS ratio

details.question: What is the postal street address for the school with the 7th highest Math average? Indicate the school's name.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."school", "schools"."street" FROM "schools" JOIN "satscores" ON "schools"."cdscode" = "satscores"."cds" ORDER BY "satscores"."avgscrmath" DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

details.question: What is the total number of non-chartered schools in the county of Los Angeles with a percent (%) of eligible free meals for grades 1 through 12 that is less than 0.18%?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "School Code") AS total_non_chartered_schools FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.18 AND "Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0

details.question: How many students from the ages of 5 to 17 are enrolled at the State Special School school in Fremont for the 2014-2015 academic year?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND f."School Name" = 'State Special School' AND s.city = 'Fremont'

details.question: Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)?
details.sql: SELECT "School Name", "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND "Low Grade" = 'K' AND "High Grade" = '9'

details.question: Between San Diego and Santa Barbara, which county offers the most number of schools that does not offer physical building? Indicate the amount.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."county" AS "county", COUNT("schools"."school") AS "school_count" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."county" IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND "schools"."virtual" = 'Y' GROUP BY "schools"."county" ORDER BY "school_count" DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."gsoffered" FROM "schools" ORDER BY "schools"."longitude" DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Of the schools that offers a magnet program serving a grade span of Kindergarten to 8th grade, how many offers Multiple Provision Types? List the number of cities that offers a Kindergarten to 8th grade span and indicate how many schools are there serving such grade span for each city.
details.sql: SELECT "schools"."city" AS "city", COUNT(*) AS "total_schools", COUNT(DISTINCT "schools"."fundingtype") AS "multiple_provision_types" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."magnet" = 1 AND "schools"."gsoffered" = 'K-8' GROUP BY "schools"."city" ORDER BY "multiple_provision_types" DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
details.sql: SELECT "District Code", "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.cdscode = schools.cdscode WHERE schools.admfname1 = 'Alusine'

details.question: What are the valid e-mail addresses of the administrator of the school located in the San Bernardino county, City of San Bernardino City Unified that opened between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010 whose school types are public Intermediate/Middle Schools and Unified Schools?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "schools"."admemail1") AS "admemail1", COUNT(DISTINCT "schools"."admemail2") AS "admemail2", COUNT(DISTINCT "schools"."admemail3") AS "admemail3" FROM "schools" WHERE "schools"."county" = 'San Bernardino' AND "schools"."district" = 'City of San Bernardino City Unified' AND "schools"."opendate" >= '2009-01-01' AND "schools"."opendate" <= '2010-12-31' AND "schools"."soctype" = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)' AND "schools"."doctype" = 'Unified School District' ORDER BY "admemail1" ASC LIMIT 100
